2610.08231.title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
2610.08231.paper_summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4
2610.08231.paper_summary_zh: NVFP4 是一種對於大型語言模型 (LLM) 推理來說具有吸引力的數據類型，提供緊湊的存儲和原生的張量核心加速。<lb/>然而，使用 NVFP4 保持準確性需要仔細的量化。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們開發了一種名為 NVFP4 的優化平滑和縮放的新型量化方案 (OSFP4)。<lb/>對於每個線性投影，它使用一個對角平滑矩陣，其條目經過優化，以最小化在 NVFP4 下的平方矩陣乘積量化誤差，考慮到所使用的四捨五入程序（無論是四捨五入到最近的數字，還是 GPTQ 風格的連續干擾消除）。<lb/>這需要對平滑條目以及區塊縮放進行聯合優化，這是通過分析一種乘法抖動 FP4 量化器而非固定的確定性量化器來促進的。<lb/>實驗顯示，OSFP4 在相應的量化設置中實現了評估競爭者中最高的平均準確性，同時在測量的工作負載上保留了大約 94-97\% 的供應商 NVFP4 預填吞吐量。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4 獲得。
